description:
Cross-platform desktop application for translation based on ChatGPT API.


Browser-like back and forward navigation between translation views
- Added browser-like back/forward navigation: clicking a word in the translation result to view its details can now be undone instantly with the back button in the bottom bar, Cmd/Ctrl+[ and ] shortcuts, or the mouse side buttons
- Going back or forward restores the previous view's result instantly from an in-memory cache, without re-running the translation
